description: Aggregate Thai-venue figures for one UK city/area, or up to five side by side. Use for totals and density, not for named venues. Returns venue count split by type, venues per 100k residents, and hygiene figures - a mean FHRS rating with the number rated, or FHIS pass/improvement counts for Scotland. Scottish venues have no numeric score and are never averaged. Counts cover venues identified in FSA data, so they are a floor.

cities.description: Up to five city/area names to compare. Use instead of city.

city.description: One UK city or area name, e.g. 'Leeds'. Accepts names as used in the dataset; rank_cities lists them.

name: get_city_stats
title: City statistics
